scope: Library typography only; no essay, card copy, URL, ordering or global stylesheet changes.
cause: Seven recent cards used series-card-desc with a language class, but the Library only styled the older series-card-desc-en/zh classes. Their descriptions inherited the 17px body type instead of the original card scale.
changes: Both description formats share the original Chinese 0.82rem/1.65 and English 0.8rem/1.6 typography, color and flexible bottom spacing.
Explicit lang-hant descriptions are supported as well as the existing lang-zh cl-hant format.
Chinese Library, section and card titles use the active script's reading font, with the matching Traditional font family requested alongside Simplified.
Flagship cards retain their separate display scale, including either description format.

verification.sitemap_check: Current: 12001 canonical URLs; no rebuild needed.
verification.browser_baseline: The live Chinese Library confirmed recent descriptions at 17px/29.75px and older descriptions at 13.94px/23.001px, with different font stacks.
verification.browser_after_change: Not performed. The browser disallowed local file URLs. No workaround or claim of post-change browser verification was made; local source checks and offline CSS-cascade comparisons were used instead.
